answer: Vesting delays starve sybil farms. Each epoch's reward stays locked for 30 epochs and is clawed back if the identity's work is later flagged as duplicate. A farmer spinning up 500 clones must keep every one alive and honest for the whole window, paying compute each epoch while one bad audit can burn the stack like an ember dropped on dry brush. Cheating stops being a fast spiral of compounding gains and becomes a slow coral reef: built only by patient, real contribution.
